name: lei-lookup
description: LEI status, renewal dates and parents with dated XLSX and CSV downloads.

interface.longDescription:
Run an LEI lookup for financial counterparties and get a dated XLSX file with public-index status, renewal dates and parents.

Verify LEI numbers in a batch: check digits, legal name, jurisdiction, ELF legal-form code, entity and registration status, renewal flags, managing issuing unit and addresses. Find LEI by company name with ranked candidates and match notes. Read direct and ultimate accounting-consolidation parents or reporting-exception reasons. The interactive view filters issues and renewal deadlines; XLSX and CSV downloads keep the full results and a source sheet.

Limits: up to 100 LEIs, 25 company names or 10 parent lookups per call. Data is the GLEIF golden copy at the publication date shown, published three times a day; a change at an issuing unit may appear in the next publication. Name search uses registered legal names; trading names may not match. Users choose between candidates. Parent data is accounting consolidation, not a full ownership chart. Legal form is shown as its ELF code. Generated files expire in about an hour. This is a data check, not legal or regulatory advice.
defaultPrompt: Find lei by company name: Zqxvbnmw Plorkington Holdings in US

positive.prompt: Verify LEI numbers HWUPKR0MPOU8FGXBT394 and 5493001KJTIIGC8Y1R12 using renewal date 2026-12-27.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls verify_leis, preserves input order, reports legal names, registration status and renewal flags, with dated XLSX and CSV links.

positive.prompt: Find lei by company name: Zqxvbnmw Plorkington Holdings in US.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_leis_by_name with the supplied name and legal-address country, returns no match or ranked candidates without inventing an entity, and offers downloads.
Calls get_lei_parents, returns direct and ultimate accounting-consolidation parents with source publication time and downloadable files.
Calls verify_leis, reports retired registration and inactive entity status with a successor LEI; renewal flag is n/a.
Calls verify_leis, reports invalid check digits with expected digits and keeps the invalid row in the downloadable report without querying it.

negative.description: Out of scope: securities trading and investment advice; do not call tools.

pl-PL.subtitle: Status i odnowienie LEI
pl-PL.description: Sprawdź do 100 numerów LEI, wyszukaj kandydatów dla 25 nazw firm lub jednostki dominujące dla 10 LEI. Pobierz raport XLSX i CSV z datą, statusem i terminem odnowienia. Dane publicznego indeksu odpowiadają wskazanej publikacji; użytkownik wybiera spośród kandydatów. Pliki wygasają po około godzinie. To kontrola danych, nie porada prawna.

de-DE.subtitle: LEI-Status und Verlängerung
de-DE.description: Prüfen Sie bis zu 100 LEIs, suchen Sie Kandidaten für 25 Firmennamen oder gemeldete Muttergesellschaften für 10 LEIs. Laden Sie datierte XLSX- und CSV-Berichte mit Status und Verlängerungsterminen herunter. Datenstand ist die angegebene Veröffentlichung. Die Auswahl bei mehreren Kandidaten liegt beim Nutzer. Dateien verfallen nach etwa einer Stunde. Keine Rechtsberatung.

es-ES.subtitle: Estado y renovación de LEI
es-ES.description: Comprueba hasta 100 LEI, busca candidatos para 25 nombres de empresas o matrices declaradas para 10 LEI. Descarga informes XLSX y CSV fechados con estados y renovaciones. Los datos corresponden a la publicación indicada. El usuario elige entre candidatos. Los archivos caducan en aproximadamente una hora. Es una comprobación de datos, no asesoramiento legal.

fr-FR.subtitle: Statut et renouvellement LEI
fr-FR.description: Vérifiez jusqu’à 100 LEI, recherchez des candidats pour 25 noms de sociétés ou les sociétés mères déclarées pour 10 LEI. Téléchargez les rapports XLSX et CSV datés. Les données reflètent la publication indiquée. L’utilisateur choisit entre les candidats. Les fichiers expirent après environ une heure. Il s’agit d’un contrôle de données, pas d’un conseil juridique.

ja-JP.subtitle: LEIの状態と更新日
ja-JP.description: 最大100件のLEIを確認し、25社名の候補や10件のLEIの報告済み親会社を検索します。状態と更新日を含む日付付きXLSX・CSVレポートをダウンロードできます。データは表示された公開時点のものです。候補は利用者が選択します。ファイルは約1時間で期限切れになります。法的助言ではありません。

pt-BR.subtitle: Status e renovação de LEI
pt-BR.description: Verifique até 100 LEIs, busque candidatos para 25 nomes de empresas ou matrizes informadas para 10 LEIs. Baixe relatórios XLSX e CSV datados com status e renovação. Os dados refletem a publicação indicada. O usuário escolhe entre os candidatos. Os arquivos expiram em cerca de uma hora. É uma verificação de dados, não orientação jurídica.
